calibration.purpose: conformal and threshold fitting, only after checkpoint selection is final

development_holdout.note: may be used repeatedly across the experiment matrix (E0-E10); it is explicitly the iteration surface, unlike the locked test

forbidden: use as the final OOD test

locked_final_test.purpose: opened exactly once, after a final configuration is selected
forbidden: any tuning or retuning based on its results
inspecting partial results during the run

may_run_when_all_true: the selected configuration is recorded in the experiment registry
no further architecture or hyperparameter tuning is planned
all required tests pass (pytest, ruff, pyright, frontend lint/test/build)
manifest hashes match between the registry record and the on-disk locked-test manifest
calibration was fit without any locked test data
reports/results/v3/final-selection.json exists before the test command starts
after_viewing_results: do not retune architecture, hyperparameters, or calibration against locked-test results
record in the experiment registry that the locked test was opened, with its run_id

never_permitted: altering, regenerating, relabeling, or inspecting locked test outcomes to make an architectural decision
modifying historical result files to make current performance appear better
replacing a failed evaluation with a hard-coded value
promoting a new default checkpoint automatically
overwriting the currently promoted HydroCore-S artifact
training HydroCore-L without all S/M work complete and an explicit machine-readable decision record
